slides.text: Three guardians remain. The Gatekeeper, in the dungeon halls. The Crimson Warden, in the vaults below. The Harbor Tyrant, at the edge of the sea.
A tap will not wake them. A swing thrown with everything you have will. Strike true.
Your pulse is the only light. Keep it burning.

levels.intro: He guards the first hall. He is slow, and he is testing you.
Faster, and he watches where you strike. Vary your swings.
The last guardian. Choose your weapon. Do not stand still.
